BLOCKER: Fail-open budget bypass: in `problems()` the new filter `if at and cutoff_dt and at >= cutoff_dt` leaves `rows` empty when `cutoff` is absent/empty (`_dt` returns None for falsy input), so `len(rows) >= max_n` never fires and the review gate is silently disabled; the prior string compare `>= ""` included all rows. Delta hunk (rows loop).

Same fail-open via corrupted evidence: rows with malformed `at` are now dropped (`except ValueError: continue`) instead of counted, so injected garbage timestamps shrink `rows` and suppress the budget gate in a gate path.
MAJOR: Regression: `cutoff_dt = _dt(cutoff)` is the only `_dt` call site not wrapped in try/except, and `_dt` no longer swallows parse errors — a malformed `cutoff` config value now raises ValueError out of `problems()` and crashes the gate with a raw traceback (previously tolerated).

Silent-drop observability gap: malformed evidence `at` values are discarded with `continue` and no diagnostic, making corruption indistinguishable from absence — the very issue the prior MAJOR on `_dt` flagged, now relocated rather than resolved.

Reuse: `_dt_safe` is added but used in exactly one place (`mats` check) while `_material_ok` and the evidence loop re-implement the same try/except ValueError guard — three copies of one policy in one file, and the helper name invites the same drift elsewhere.
MINOR: Naive timestamps are silently coerced with `dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)`; a local-time `at` is treated as UTC and can flip `at >= latest` ordering with no log or flag.

A MATERIAL_CHANGE decision with missing/empty `at` skips the `MATERIAL_APPROVAL_INVALID` branch (guarded by `str(d.get("at") or "")` truthiness) and falls through to `MATERIAL_APPROVAL_ORDER`, conflating "no timestamp" with "stale timestamp".
`cutoff_dt = _dt(cutoff)` is recomputed per mode inside the loop rather than once before it — the same single-pass cleanup the delta applied elsewhere.
SUMMARY: The delta correctly resolves two prior MAJORs (string-vs-datetime filter mismatch; wrong code when no MATERIAL_CHANGE exists) and narrows `_dt`'s exception surface, but introduces a fail-open budget bypass on missing cutoff and on corrupted evidence timestamps, plus an uncaught crash path on malformed cutoff.
`MATERIAL_APPROVAL_*` codes remain message-string-only telemetry, and `_dt_safe` is added without being adopted at the other two guard sites.
Top risks before merge: make the budget filter fail-closed when `cutoff` is absent/malformed, wrap or reuse `_dt_safe` at `cutoff_dt`, and log (not silently drop) unparseable evidence rows.
